Legal

Privacy policy

Last updated 30 September 2026

CCM Secretarial (Corporate Consultant & Management) (“CCM”, “we”, “us”) respects your privacy. This policy explains how we collect, use and protect personal data when you visit this website or contact us, in line with Malaysia’s Personal Data Protection Act 2010 (“PDPA”).

1. Who we are

CCM Secretarial, 1, Jalan Elmina Ilham 18, Seksyen U16, Elmina, Shah Alam, Selangor, Malaysia. Phone: 016-477 9365. Email: corpsec@ccmsecretarial.com.

2. Personal data we collect

  • Information you give us — your name, phone number, email address, company name, the services you are interested in and any message you send through our enquiry form, WhatsApp, email or phone.
  • Information needed for our services — if you become a client, we also collect identity, company and financial information required to provide company secretarial, accounting, audit and tax services.
  • Technical information — basic technical data such as browser type and pages visited, if analytics tools are enabled on this website.

3. How we use your data

  • To respond to your enquiry and give you a quote;
  • To provide and administer our services and meet our professional and legal obligations, including filings with SSM and LHDN;
  • To send reminders and compliance updates relevant to your company;
  • To improve our website and services.

4. Disclosure

We do not sell your personal data. We may disclose it to government and regulatory bodies (such as SSM and LHDN) where needed to provide our services, to service providers who help us run our business (for example messaging, email and IT providers) under confidentiality obligations, and where the law requires it.

5. WhatsApp and email

If you contact us through WhatsApp or email, your messages are handled on those platforms, which have their own privacy policies. Please avoid sending sensitive information, such as full identity numbers or bank details, until we have agreed a secure way to exchange documents.

6. Security and retention

We take reasonable steps to protect personal data from loss, misuse and unauthorised access. We keep data only as long as needed for the purposes above and to meet legal, tax and professional record-keeping requirements.

7. Your rights

Under the PDPA you may request access to, or correction of, your personal data, and you may withdraw your consent to certain uses. To do so, email corpsec@ccmsecretarial.com. We may need to verify your identity first.

8. Cookies and analytics

This website does not currently use advertising cookies. If we add analytics in future, we will update this policy and, where required, ask for your consent.

9. Changes to this policy

We may update this policy from time to time. The date at the top shows when it was last revised.

10. Contact

Questions about this policy? Email corpsec@ccmsecretarial.com or call 016-477 9365.

This policy is a general statement and should be reviewed by CCM’s legal adviser before publication.
